title: A contributor changes the terms
text: A fictional interview contributor sends a request: 'Please do not make a voice that answers as me. I might approve a few attributed excerpts if I can review their context and withdraw them later.' The committee must consider how this changes the proposed exhibit. This grants no permission yet.

title: The budget shrinks
text: The available budget falls from 6,000 to 3,000 credits. The eight-week deadline remains. No additional staff time or funding has been promised. Revise the scope, postpone, or explain what you would decline to do.
